newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Anda loses 5.57 mln yuan in first half.
newsitem.headline: Anda loses 5.57 mln yuan in first half.

text.p: Shenzhen Shekou Anda Industry Co Ltd said on Tuesday it incurred a loss of 5.57 million yuan in the first half of 1996 against net earnings of 13.37 million yuan recorded in the same period last year.

In an interim report published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times, Anda said that under Chinese accounting standards, its main operating income fell to 158.851 million yuan from the year earlier's level of 285.182 million yuan.
Anda said the first half loss was due in part to higher finance-related costs in light of Beijing's credit clampdown.
